name: hades-openspec-workflow
description: PRD-first OpenSpec workflow for Codex: analyze requirements, create split PRD documents, generate OpenSpec artifacts, apply confirmed plans, review, and archive.

interface.shortDescription: PRD-first OpenSpec delivery workflow for Codex.
interface.longDescription: Hades OpenSpec Workflow enforces a PRD-first delivery loop: requirement analysis, impact-based Chinese PRD document groups, user confirmation, OpenSpec artifact generation, confirmation-gated implementation, verification, review, and archive. It does not create GitHub Issues.
defaultPrompt: Process this request through Hades OpenSpec Workflow.
Create PRD docs, then propose an OpenSpec change.
